ults.config.title: UltStorage
ults.config.local_only: This screen only saves this client's local config/ults/ults.json. Run /ults reload on an integrated server to apply it; it cannot modify a remote dedicated server.
ults.config.language.tooltip: Language used for server-rendered commands and storage UI.
ults.config.item_visibility.tooltip:
Which items the storage screen lists. Run /ults reload to apply.
Show everything: every item and category, even with nothing stored
Survival obtainable: always lists what a survival player can obtain (modded items included), anything else only while it is stored, and categories without content are hidden
Stocked only: only items in stock, categories without stock are hidden
ults.config.storage_mode.tooltip:
Where the stored items live. Run /ults reload to apply.
Void: input containers feed a server-side void store
Remote: no void store, items are aggregated from and taken out of the bound containers (only while their chunk is loaded)
ults.config.permission.tooltip: Vanilla permission level 0-4 required to bind containers, to delete bindings and to toggle the highlight.
ults.config.multi_block_containers.toolt: Block ids whose directly connected blocks together form one large container, for modded containers that give every part its own inventory. Vanilla chests, trapped chests and copper chests are recognised on their own. Example: modid:big_chest
ults.config.multi_block_containers.inval: Enter the id of a block that exists in this game.
ults.config.max_bindings.tooltip: Maximum containers the storage may bind; 0 means unlimited.
ults.config.drain_interval.tooltip: How many ticks between two drain visits of the same input container (1 = every tick). Larger values save server time on huge warehouses; items then wait a moment longer in the input container.
ults.config.save_success.detail: The local JSON was validated and saved. Run /ults reload to apply it.
ults.config.save_failed.detail: The local configuration was not saved.
